compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: A Spirit of grace and supplication is poured on David’s house and Jerusalem; looking on the pierced one leads into extensive household mourning.
observations.label: A poured Spirit accompanies looking and mourning

observations.body: The passage presents Looking and mourning as the scene's observable response or movement.

observations.body: The passage places House of David and Jerusalem beside Looking and mourning.

payload.posture: Read Zechariah 12:10–14 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a Spirit of grace and supplication is poured on David’s house and Jerusalem; looking on the pierced one leads into extensive household mourning. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: A poured Spirit accompanies looking and mourning
